cando: I can introduce myself and other people.
I can ask and answer simple questions about my home, my family, my school and my day.
I can buy things, order food and ask where places are.
cando_ar: أستطيع أن أسأل وأجيب عن أسئلة بسيطة عن بيتي وأسرتي ومدرستي ويومي.
أستطيع أن أشتري وأطلب الطعام وأسأل عن الأماكن.

a: Yes, I'm a high school student.
cards.do: Ask a new girl if she is a student.
cards.do_m: Ask a new boy if he is a student.
cards.do_ar: اسألي فتاة جديدة: هل هي طالبة؟
cards.do_ar_m: اسأل فتى جديدًا: هل هو طالب؟

a: I speak Arabic and a little English.
cards.do: Ask your friend what languages she speaks.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend what languages he speaks.
cards.do_ar: اسألي صديقتك عن اللغات التي تتكلمها.
cards.do_ar_m: اسأل صديقك عن اللغات التي يتكلمها.

cards.do: Ask your friend where her school is.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend where his school is.

cards.q: Introduce yourself to a new teacher.
Introduce your sister to your friend.
cards.q_m: Introduce your brother to your friend.
a: Lama, this is my sister, Reem.
This is my sister. Her name is Reem.
a_m: Khalid, this is my brother, Fahad.
This is my brother. His name is Fahad.

cards.do: Ask your friend her best friend's name.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend his best friend's name.
cards.do_ar: اسألي صديقتك عن اسم صديقتها المقرّبة.
cards.do_ar_m: اسأل صديقك عن اسم صديقه المقرّب.

cards.do: Ask your friend what her father does.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend what his father does.

cards.ar: هل تسكنين في بيت أم شقة؟
cards.ar_m: هل تسكن في بيت أم شقة؟
cards.q: Do you live in a house or an apartment?
cards.do: Ask your friend: a house or an apartment?
cards.do_ar: اسألي صديقتك: هل تسكن في بيت أم شقة؟
cards.do_ar_m: اسأل صديقك: هل يسكن في بيت أم شقة؟

cards.q: How many bedrooms are there in your home?
cards.do: Ask your friend how many bedrooms her home has.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend how many bedrooms his home has.

cards.do_ar_m: اسأل صديقك عن عدد غرف النوم في بيته.

a: The living room, because it's big.
cards.do: Ask your friend about her favorite room.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend about his favorite room.

cards.q: Describe your home to a friend.
steps: Say what is in your bedroom.
a: In my room, there's a bed and a desk.
My favorite room is the living room.

cards.q: What time do you get up on school days?
a: I get up at six o'clock.
I usually get up at half past five.
cards.do: Ask your friend when she gets up.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend when he gets up.

cards.q: How do you get to school?
a: I go by car. My father drives me.
cards.do: Ask your friend how she gets to school.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend how he gets to school.
cards.do_ar: اسألي صديقتك كيف تذهب إلى المدرسة.
cards.do_ar_m: اسأل صديقك كيف يذهب إلى المدرسة.

cards.q: What do you do after school?
a: I have lunch and do my homework.
I rest, and then I study.
cards.do: Ask your friend what she does after school.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend what he does after school.
cards.do_ar: اسألي صديقتك ماذا تفعل بعد المدرسة.
cards.do_ar_m: اسأل صديقك ماذا يفعل بعد المدرسة.

cards.q: Tell a friend about your school day.
steps: Say how you get to school.
Say one thing you do after school.
a: I get up at six o'clock.
I go to school by car.
After school, I do my homework.

cards.ar: ماذا تحبين أن تفعلي في وقت فراغك؟
cards.ar_m: ماذا تحب أن تفعل في وقت فراغك؟

a: Yes, I love it! I make cakes.

cards.do_m: Ask your friend if he likes cooking.

steps: Say one thing you like doing.
Say how often you do it.
Say who you do it with.
Say one thing you don't like doing.

a: Yes. I'd like a chicken burger, please.
I'd like a salad and a juice, please.

a: I'd like the chicken with rice, please.

cards.do: Ask your friend about her favorite subject.
cards.do_m: Ask your friend about his favorite subject.

Ask your classmate who the English teacher is.

steps: Say how many classes you have a day.
Say one thing you like about school.

I like my friends at school.
Yes, I'm looking for a notebook.

cards.q: How much is this pen, please?
cards.do: Ask the shop assistant the price of the pen. Say please.

cards.q: Buy a gift in a shop.
steps: Say what you are looking for.
a: I'm looking for a gift for my mother.

cards.q: Excuse me, where's the library, please?

Ask your sister where her phone is.
